scope: Read-only independent Windows runtime/MIC, package-byte/alias/history verification plus source/receipt review of ROOT approved scoped install and isolated installed-entry smoke. Reviewer performs no global write.

root_cause.approved_context: One approved tool pwsh isMedium8192. Low-labelled venv launcher and actual Python child areLow4096; direct pre-existing base executable remainsMedium8192. Both approved-context paths report TokenIsAppContainer=false.
root_cause.default_context: Default restricted tool pwsh isLow4096/AppContainer; both venv and direct-base children remainLow/AppContainer. Using base Python does not elevate a low parent.
root_cause.file_labels: venv file S:AI(ML;ID;NW;;;LW); base interpreter and target skill directories have no explicit label and therefore implicitMedium.
root_cause.DACL: Independently read ownerFullControl and CodexSandboxUsers ReadAndExecute entries. IsTokenRestricted=false is not evidence ofMedium or absence ofMIC/AppContainer; TokenHasRestrictions remains recordedtrue.
root_cause.causal_assessment: MIC no-write-up is a sufficient and reproducible explanation for approved-shell venv EACCES despite owner write permissions. The approved base runtime removes unintended integrity reduction while preserving the original supported approval context, canonical installer and narrow paths. No directory/file relabel, ACL rewrite, admin elevation or sandbox bypass is required or performed by reviewer.
